invariants.rationale: The method always returns 0 or a greater value--either 0 in the empty case, text.length() in the bounds case, or a character index (Math.max(0, i-1) or i).
If there are any breaks, the computed result is always within the current line's start and end indices or at text.length().
If there are any line breaks, the result returned is at most text.length().
If the cursorLine * 2 >= linesBreak.size, then result will be text.length() by direct return.
When linesBreak.size > 0 and cursorLine * 2 >= linesBreak.size, result is text.length(); if cursorLine * 2 < linesBreak.size, result is a char index in that line.
